status: Specified after source audit and before forecast evaluation; not preregistered
author: H. Esad Kay
primary_loss: Provider-balanced mean absolute log error, aggregated by origin and then time

excluded_sources_reason.gcp: Audited on-demand labels can contain discounted/spot SKU contamination; do not use retrospective price filters
excluded_sources_reason.runpod: Historical secure/community tiers and label changes cannot be consistently distinguished from common fields
excluded_sources_reason.other: No exact target GPU labels in the selected snapshots

headline_weighting: Separate market/horizon; equal origin, equal provider within origin, equal key within provider-origin. GPU-specific cells reported separately.
ridge_weighting: Equal origin; equal provider within origin; equal example within provider-origin. Weighted feature mean and variance.
